referenceDna.annotatedDescription: The official Aptive residential pest control homepage was inspected in paired desktop and mobile full-page captures. The page opens with a dark-green photographic stage with a technician in a yard and a bright lime call action. It uses light service navigation with a strong quote control and a slim offer strip. The visual system relies on rounded modern sans statements with calm small explanatory copy; surfaces include forest green, warm off-white, pale sage and accents include lime green, muted sage. Imagery is technician and home-garden scenes framed by organic leaf and lawn imagery. The page then runs through service navigation, technician-led image hero, four prevention benefits, proactive statement image band, promise and quote form, pest index, three-step visit process, forecast and coverage, reviews, advice, FAQ, footer. Its service presentation is small pest-category pictograms and a three-part inspection-treatment-communication process. Mobile changes to keep the service promise and quote action early, use single-column prevention benefits, and keep pest icons legible. Transfer only the layout rhythm and decision path. Do not copy the Aptive promise, staff imagery, pest forecast data, offer, review text, guarantees, or environmental claims.

acceptanceChecks: The opening accurately names the client's verified home-service trades scope and presents an immediate next action.
The service, process, proof, and contact chapters follow the reference's observed decision rhythm without copying its identity.
Desktop and mobile captures show a readable page without width overflow or hidden conversion controls.
Every claim, image, review, credential, location, and contact detail in the generated client page is independently verified.
